# Requirements

`req~card-refusal~1`

If a card is declined, then the meter shall keep the barrier closed.

`req~daily-cap~1`

The meter shall charge no more than twenty dollars for one day.

`req~entry-time~1`

When a car enters, the meter shall record the entry time to the minute.

`req~ev-discount~1`

Where the car is electric, the meter shall take ten percent off the fare.

`req~fare-rounding~1`

The meter shall round each fare up to the next ten cents.

`req~full-sign~1`

While every space is taken, the meter shall show the full sign.

`req~grace-period~1`

When a car leaves within ten minutes of entry, the meter shall charge nothing.

`req~lost-ticket~1`

If a ticket is lost, then the meter shall charge the daily cap.

`req~night-rate~1`

While the clock is between ten at night and six in the morning, the meter shall charge half the hourly rate.

`req~receipt-total~1`

When a fare is paid, the meter shall print a receipt with the total.
